episodeTitle.en: Why product-led growth is the future | Elena Verna (Amplitude, Miro, Surveymonkey)
episodeTitle.zh: 为何产品主导增长是未来趋势 | 埃琳娜·维尔纳（Amplitude、Miro、Surveymonkey）

guestBioOfficial.en: Elena Verna has led growth at some of today’s most successful B2B businesses, including Miro as CMO, Surveymonkey as SVP of Growth, and now at Amplitude as interim Head of Growth. She’s also worked closely with over a dozen companies on growth and product strategy, including companies like MongoDB, Clockwise, and Netlify (where she sits on the board of directors). Elena is undoubtedly one of the smartest people on growth strategy in the world.
guestBioOfficial.zh: 埃琳娜·维尔纳曾在当今一些最成功的B2B企业领导增长团队，包括在Miro担任首席营销官，在Surveymonkey担任增长副总裁，现在在Amplitude担任临时增长主管。她还与十几家公司密切合作，参与增长和产品战略，包括MongoDB、Clockwise和Netlify（她在Netlify担任董事会成员）。埃琳娜无疑是全球增长战略领域最聪明的人之一。

title.en: Why product-led growth is the future | Elena Verna (Amplitude, Miro, Surveymonkey)
title.zh: 为何产品主导增长是未来趋势 | 埃琳娜·维尔纳（Amplitude、Miro、Surveymonkey）

summary.en: Elena Verna gives a deep, opinionated masterclass on product-led sales (PLS) — the emerging go-to-market motion that turns self-serve usage into larger sales-led contracts. She distinguishes PLG (individual, self-serve monetization capped around $10K) from PLS, which builds a "bridge" from an individual user's job-to-be-done up to an enterprise-level solution, with sales owning the escalator because products are bad at conveying enterprise value. Key concepts covered: PQA (product-qualified account) vs PQL vs MQL and the three lead-attribution channels; why every sales-led company should add a product-assist element and make product accountable for pipeline; the four roles needed (product, analytics, marketing, sales) and a "Wizard of Oz" start before buying tooling; behavioral signals like admin switches and terms-of-use page views; and common pitfalls (treating PLS like top-down sales, spamming users, excluding marketing). She stresses patience (12+ months of usage before enterprise contracts) and ends by speculating that AI will automate sales conversations next.
summary.zh: Elena Verna 给了一堂有观点、极深入的产品驱动销售（PLS）大师课——这是一种新兴的 go-to-market 打法，把自助用量转化成更大的、销售驱动的合同。她区分了 PLG（个人的、自助变现上限约 1 万美元）和 PLS：PLS 在个人的"待完成任务"和企业级方案之间建一座"桥"，由销售拥有那部扶梯，因为产品不擅长传达企业价值。涵盖的关键概念：PQA（产品合格账户）vs PQL vs MQL，以及三种线索归因渠道；为什么每个销售驱动公司都该加"产品辅助"元素、并让产品对管道可问责；需要的四个角色（产品、分析、营销、销售）以及买工具前"绿野仙踪式"的起步；管理员切换、使用条款页浏览等行为信号；以及常见坑（把 PLS 当自上而下销售、spam 用户、排除营销）。她强调耐心（企业合同前需 12 个月以上用量），最后猜想下一步 AI 会自动化销售对话。
